annotations.text:
For the Stitch brief:
Ground #fbfaf7, ink #1a1a18, accent #b3401b, control-pass #2f6f5e.
Source Serif 4 + IBM Plex Mono. Square corners everywhere — no rounded pills.
Every number is monospace with tabular figures.

All figures are measured, from artifact/data/*.json — 27,776 params, 8,192 state entries, targeted 77.2% vs control 100.0% at 2.06x removed mass.
Only the four distractor probabilities in the prediction bars are illustrative; p(Oslo) 0.960 and 0.614 are real.
